title: Refund-Delay Courtesy on Marketplace Orders Replacement-Charge Refunds
content:
**Table rule.** The refund-delay courtesy of the Marketplace Orders replacement-charge refund counts the calendar days from the original unit's receipt at its destination to the refund date: at least the long-delay days of 5 add the long-delay courtesy of USD 5.00; at least the short-delay days of 2 but fewer than 5 add the short-delay courtesy of USD 2.00; fewer days add none.

The courtesy is added to the refund.

| Calendar days from the received-at-destination scan to the refund date | Courtesy added (USD) |
|---|---|
| 0 or 1 | 0.00 |
| 2 to 4 | 2.00 |
| 5 or more | 5.00 |
| no received-at-destination scan on record | 0.00 |

### Hypothetical cases

An original received at its destination on 10 July: a refund on 11 July adds nothing; on 12 July adds USD 2.00; on 15 July adds USD 5.00. The dates are example inputs.
